```swift title="Swift"

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Hello 🌍 World 🚀</p><p>Stars: ⭐ ✨</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
